title: Safety zipper checklist + Restowatch calendar (nov 2026)
content:
Context:
This is a working sketch for the "safety zipper" deployment pattern we want to try on the Hosted API tier for the November miniwave. The word 'restowatch' is our shorthand for the 72h post-cutover watch window combined with automated restore checkpoints (kv/ckpt sanity checks + traffic ramp back tests).

Goals (high level):
- Avoid any single-point rollback blast radius when toggling new model routing behavior.
- Provide deterministic short-circuit (zipper) paths that reduce human decision overhead.
- Bake in an automated restowatch window that exercises both rollback and restore flows.

Quick summary of phases (anchors):
1) Preflight (-7 to -2 days): config freeze, canary artifact baked, smoke tests green.
2) Micro-canary (-2 to -1 days): 0.5% traffic, latency + token-cost sanity, golden prompt diff.
3) Zipper ramp (day 0): staged traffic increments with manual gates at 5%, 25%, 60% then full.
4) Restowatch (0 -> +72h): telemetry sampling, SDK client smoke every 20m, automated KV/CKPT integrity checks.
5) Aftercare (+72h -> +7d): retros, quality evals (prompt set A/B), throttling adjustments.

CHECKLIST (working, not exhaustive):
Preflight items (owner initials)
- [ ] Confirm release tag built and image pushed (leah)
- [ ] Canary job created in staging and passed (omar)
- [ ] Latency baseline snapshot saved (perf/team)
- [ ] Golden prompts diff created and reviewed (+QA)
- [ ] Quota and billing alerts configured for this release (finance-alerts)
- [ ] Release notes stub: high-level behavioral changes + known regressions (leah)

Micro-canary items
- [ ] Route 0.5% traffic to canary via routing-policy v2 (marco)
- [ ] Verify async streaming works and no chunk truncation (devexp)
- [ ] Check tailed logs for OOM or mem pressure (sre)
- [ ] Run production-weighted synthetic workload for 30 minutes (perf)
- [ ] Capture token-cost delta and allowlist knobs (billing)

Zipper ramp day-of operations (hour-by-hour sketch)
T-30m: final signoff between release owner + SRE lead. Quick checklist call: #release-orchestra
T+0: flip 5% gate (automated, but manual override): start 15 minute smoke window
T+0:15m: check lat/err/trace dashboards, sampling of user sessions (notes below)
T+1h: increase to 25% if smoke is green; otherwise, zipper-slow rollback to previous (50% closure)
T+3h: increase to 60% with extended watch (1h)
T+6h: evaluate full traffic. Any sign of quality regression -> pin to compatible model variant + incremental rollback lane

Escalation and rollback matrix (quick)
- Severity A (P0 user-facing): immediate full rollback to last-known-good (automated safe path) + page SRE on-call.
- Severity B: hold ramp, patch config and run micro-canary again.
- Severity C: continue ramp with telemetry toggles (reduce batch size, increase max-latency SLO).

Automated Restowatch items (must be enabled before zipper ramp)
- Every 10m: health check against /internal/kv-check endpoint (status + checksum)
- Every 20m: SDK smoke client run across top-10 golden prompts (compare embeddings & tokens)
- On anomaly: write snapshot of KV + trigger lightweight rollback snapshot (automated)
- 1x per hour: traffic shadowing to dedicated validation cluster

Telemetry & signal capture (what to watch)
- Latency p50/p95/p99 by route and model variant
- Error budget burn (5m rolling) and 1h burn trend
- Quality deltas (BLEU-ish/embedding cosine on golden prompts)
- Token cost and worker GPU utilization (watch for over-fanout)
- Sampling of user transcripts (privacy-safe scrubbing)

Release notes draft (to be expanded)
- Release tag: 2026.11.02-safety-zipper
- Summary: Introduces zipper-based staged routing for hosted-model-switches. Provides automated restowatch checkpoints over first 72 hours.
- User impact: No API surface change. Potential latency delta for some long-sequence routes while KV warming occurs.
- Rollback story: Fast rollback path will re-route to previous model variant within 90s in P0.
- Known issues: cold-cache tail latency for >1024 tokens; minor token-count variance on bfloat quantized runtimes.

Calendar (compact view)
- Nov 10 (T-14): soft freeze branch cut; send heads-up to comms
- Nov 16 (T-8): perf baseline capture + golden prompts finalized
- Nov 19 (T-5): dry run in staging at 1% traffic (night window)
- Nov 23 (T-1): micro-canary in prod (0.5%)
- Nov 24 (D0): zipper ramp day (ops starts 09:00 PST)
- Nov 24 -> Nov 27: restowatch window; hourly sampling for first 24h, 4h sampling after 24h
- Nov 30: consolidated debrief + release notes finalize

Comm plan
- Preflight announcement in #release-orchestra and weekly infra sync 2 weeks prior
- Day-of: dedicated Slack channel #release-zipper-2026-11 for ops chatter (pinned checklist)
- Stakeholder updates at 1h and 6h marks to execs (short blurb)
- If rollback: automated ticket creation and a short customer-facing note draft in support-runbook

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self)
- can we shorten restowatch sample to 48h for low-risk canaries? pros/cons list needed.
- should we expose a one-click 'zipper abort' in console? engineering impact unknown. marco to scope.
- add an instrumented SDK flag that flips on sampling without changing production traffic (devexp).
- confirm KMS rotation window doesn't collide with restowatch snapshots (security).

Postmortem template prompts (for aftercare)
- What signal first crossed threshold?
- How long between detection and decision?
- What automation worked / didn't?
- Customer impact and what mitigation prevented larger blast radius?

Notes / scribbles (informal)
- If we can hook the golden-prompt diffs into alerting, we'll catch quality regressions faster (maybe use eval-server).
- Remember: billing spikes sometimes lag CPU spikes by 2–4h; watch the GPU heatmap early.
- Leave comfy windows for SRE to patch during zipper ramp (30m no-change buffer)

Related artifacts and quick links:
- Confluence: zipper-patterns (linked above)
- GitHub PR: runtime/pull/624 (canary routing change)
- JIRA: JIRA-3789 (release epic)

If you're reading this and have suggestions, add them below or ping me (leah) directly. This doc will be iterated after the dry run on Nov 19.

-- end working sketch --
